author: Matt Wolfe
description:
A lot of people are wondering if OpenAI is nearing their downfall…

Since they are bleeding billions of dollars a year, they’re rolling out cheaper plans to generate more revenue since not enough people are buying their $20 and $200/month plans. And recently they announced they will be introducing advertising in ChatGPT.

The ads will be in the free tier and the new $8/month cheaper plan tier.

On the other hand, Google, who famously makes most of their money from ads, says they have no plans to put ads inside their chatbots yet.

So are you sticking with ChatGPT with ads, or moving to a different model?

#OpenAI #ChatGPT #TechNews #AI
title: Will Ads in ChatGPT Ruin OpenAI?
